text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day.
While looking something up in the library—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyah?!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Problem encountered. Multiple books have fallen to the floor.
Rice-san, I propose suspending data collection.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Awa... I-I'm so, so sorry!
choice_data_list: Are you alright? Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Detecting presence of injuries—pain sensation: normal.
Determining status as 'unharmed.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Rice is okay too.
But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm really sorry... It's because Rice offered to help
carry the books that this happened.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice brought bad luck again...

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative.
The cause of the book fall was—

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I determine it was due to stacking all 50 volumes
of 'Besties ☆ Buddies Club' past safe limits.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It is an illustrated guidebook aimed at
achieving smooth interpersonal communication.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I am currently verifying the true identity of a mysterious emotion.
Following data collection,
I estimated this literature to be optimal.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. It occurs every time the
'subject of interest' enters my field of vision.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—For example, when the 'subject of interest' is running on the track,
locking visual contact for 3 seconds or more...
First, my heart rate elevates.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Next, my chest begins to generate heat,
and my cognitive process... that is... enters saturation
with this vague, mysterious emotion.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Inferring a system error from these symptoms,
I reported the situation to Father—

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"—I see. It sounds like you simply
want to become closer friends with that person."

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... Verify whether those feelings are genuine,
and report your findings back to me."

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I received the
'Friendship Mission' from Father.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing!
To be thought of like that by Bourbon-san.
She must be such a wonderful person...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, well then... Rice should get going.
I don't want Rice's bad luck to get in the way of your research.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Query: In the way?
For the execution of this mission, the 'subject of interest'—

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Namely, you, Rice-san, are an indispensable component.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeeeh?!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Query. Why are you surprised?
As you stated moments ago,
you are indeed a 'wonderful person,' Rice-san.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
F-Fueeeh?! Wh-Wh-What?!
R-R-Rice is... w-wonde...?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
F-Fueeeh?! Wh-Wh-What?!
R-R-Rice is... w-wonde...?!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmation count increased.
Determining that the validity of my claim has risen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Au au ah! B-But, um, you see, Rice is
n-n-not wonderful at all...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because if you stay with me, bad things will happen!
So... I-I'm happy you think that, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice isn't good enough for Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. No bad luck
has occurred since I first met you.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In fact, without Rice-san, the mission cannot proceed.
...In short, it would cause a system critical error.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on the above... I request Rice-san's
cooperation in this 'Friendship Mission.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What should I do...? I don't want to make
something bad happen to you, but... but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—...! All right... Rice will help!
With the 'Friendship Mission'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... though still a bit awkward,
the two took their first steps together
toward becoming closer friends.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Agitation detected from Rice-san.
If my statement was improper, I apologize.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No! That's not it!
Um... I was just a little startled...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Phew... Calm down, calm down...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you see... I'm really happy, but
Rice really shouldn't.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because if you stay with me, bad things will happen.
Rice... isn't good enough for Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. No bad luck
has occurred since I first met you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh... B-But... something might happen later,
and cause trouble for you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In fact, without Rice-san, the mission cannot proceed.
In short... 'that itself would cause trouble.'

text_block_list.name: Miho no Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on the above... I request Rice-san's
cooperation in this 'Friendship Mission.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What should I do...? I don't want to make
something bad happen to you, but... but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—...! All right... Rice will help!
With the 'Friendship Mission'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... though still a bit awkward,
the two took their first steps together
toward becoming closer friends.
